subject: A500 full-membership daily bars pilot, 2025-08-29..2025-09-30 (pendding item 8)

stores.note: both roots are gitignored generated data; the digest inventories beside this record are the reviewable artifact

ingest.run_reports: uq-ingest writes one report per session into <bars_root>/runs/<run_id>.json (gitignored); the partition manifest carries the same identities, which bars-inventory.json pins
ingest.pilot_driver: the window itself came from an inline per-session loop over build_tushare_v2_pipeline; uq-ingest daily --pipeline v2 now reproduces that path from the membership store

informational_findings.reason: no bars in the window and tushare stock_basic(list_status=D) marks it delisted

limitations: publish_lag_days=5 is an assumption, not a measurement: index_weight exposes no visibility timestamp, so membership visibility is a monthly approximation with an unverified lag (pendding item 1 owns the measurement).
the trading calendar comes from the same vendor as the bars (tushare trade_cal), so bar_session_gap proves internal consistency, not vendor-independent session coverage.
the v2 pipeline publishes unvalidated lineage: every field records compared_rows=0 and no validated_by source, so no cross-source corroboration backs these partitions.

the delisting exemption is conservative. At 2000 tushare points stock_basic does not return out_date and namechange carries no record for 601989, so only members with zero bars in the window are excused; partial gaps stay blocking.
23 sessions with a 5-session label horizon is a smoke-training window, not a research-grade backtest window.

corporate actions are carried as the vendor adj_factor only; there is no XDXR/dividend cross-check importer because the derived multiplier could not be reconciled against authoritative reference prices.
reproduction: for each session: uq-ingest daily --date <session> --data-root data/bars-a500-store --pipeline v2 --membership-root data/a500-store --universe-id a500

local_gate.command: uv sync --locked --extra dev --extra real && uv run --no-sync python -m pytest
local_gate.scope: single local cell (macOS arm64 / Python 3.12); the per-cell gate artifacts of the remote matrix are not archived here -- see remote_ci for what the remote run covers

remote_ci.coverage: six base cells (macOS/Ubuntu x Python 3.11-3.13) plus four qlib-runtime cells plus f4-certification
remote_ci.note: both runs are recorded because each evidence-only commit moves HEAD past the run that verified it; per-cell gate artifacts were not archived, so remote_ci records status and bound commits only and the local gate report stays the only per-cell evidence

runs.covers: the archive itself (inventories, readiness output, re-pinned digests)
the index producer guard and tests/test_store_evidence.py on top of the archive
